Cost: 3,500eb (Luxury)
Class: Excellent Quality SMG
Range: Carbine
Pre-installed: Drum Magazine, Improved Silencer, Power Rebuild, Short Scope (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 4), Suppressive Fire

Single Shot fires a 2-round burst. Listeners take -2 to Perception to hear it fire (Improved Silencer).

Foundry notes:

  • Damage is 4d6, dropping the 2 lowest dice. CPR 0.92.4 can't drop dice automatically, so drop them by hand from the damage roll.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
